### Enable/Disable RuntimeDiagnostics

**Enable RuntimeDiagnostics** installs the Replication Infrastructure and configures replicated data in the associated AnalyticsDatabase instance.  
**Disable RuntimeDiagnostics** removes the RuntimeDiagnostics instance, which deletes the Replication Infrastructure and all replicated data from the AnalyticsDatabase instance.

The **Enable/Disable RuntimeDiagnostics** option is available as a **Post Provisioning Pod Add-on** action. When the action is selected, PipelineHub checks the current RuntimeDiagnostics status for the pod. If RuntimeDiagnostics is disabled, the **Enable RuntimeDiagnostics** action is made available. If RuntimeDiagnostics is already enabled, the **Disable RuntimeDiagnostics** action is available instead.

* As a precursor, lets understand what accounts for an AnalyticsDatabase quota
	+ When the RuntimeDiagnostics is enabled, either during provisioning or during post action.
	+ When a CDP cloudnative service is provisioned or patched.
* Starting this release, when an user opts for AnalyticsDatabase, the quota is checked against the LOB/SubLOB.
* Please contact the sustenance, if you dont have quota to submit a AnalyticsDatabase pod.ANALYTICSDATABASE Quota will be restricted/controlled

### **Support Enable RuntimeDiagnostics added as a Post POD action.**

### Disable RuntimeDiagnostics on an existing POD

Disable RuntimeDiagnostics option is now available. For newly provisioned pods we will have the correct metadata on the POD but for existing pods, please use this option only if you are sure that the pod has RUNTIMEDIAGNOSTICS.  

Disable RuntimeDiagnostics  does the deletion of RuntimeDiagnostics Instance, resulting in the removal of the Replication Infrastructure and Replicated Data from the AnalyticsDatabase instance. On the other hand, enabling RuntimeDiagnostics does the installation of the Replication Infrastructure and the setup of replicated data in AnalyticsDatabase instance. Furthermore, it is possible to enable RuntimeDiagnostics again after disabling it.

Keep in mind this operation takes several hours and PipelineHub monitoring reports the status back to user.  

Further more, you need to disable RuntimeDiagnostics prior to running RESTORE.

NOTE: For older pods, this action might fail if RuntimeDiagnostics is not enabled.

### Save the Filter

Users can now save filter in Patching Dashboard

### Support for Enabling and Disabling RuntimeDiagnostics for Central DIT pods in Patching Dashboard

We now allow the ability to enable as well as disable RuntimeDiagnostics on a central DIT pod, from the patching dashboard. The action can be triggered from the dashboard, the status and the details of the action itself can be found by looking at the Pod History section in the pod details. Selecting the ID of the enable/disable RuntimeDiagnostics action will give you more details about the action itself.

**PipelineHub will not allow patch submission if RuntimeDiagnostics workflow is running on the pod**

* PipelineHub will now not allow submission of a new patch, from the Patching Dashboard, if the RuntimeDiagnostics PostDowntime Workflow is either currently **In progress** on the pod or is in the **NeedsAttention** stage
* This is to avoid failure of the submitted patch in the Prepare Phase.
* A new stage CHECK RuntimeDiagnostics WORKREQUEST is introduced in the dashboard for this purpose, and failure of this stage will block the user from submitting a new patch

Monitoring
----------

### MonitoringAgent Monitoring for Patching

MonitoringAgent Monitoring from PipelineHub is now supported for all ApplicationPatchBundle/ApplicationProvisioner/ReportingPatchBundle patches submitted on Gen1 and EnvironmentService now. This is not enabled by default, users can select this option if they wish to get their job monitored. 

### MonitoringAgent Monitoring support from UI for patching

Except for CloudNative, PipelineHub UI now supports MonitoringAgent Monitoring check for all other flavors of patching.

**EnableGRC** would selected and non editable for central pods. For all other Prefight/Family pod - Users have an option to select or deselect.

### Enable MonitoringAgent Monitoring by default for Backup/Restore for that job in PipelineHub UI

Backup and Restore now allows MonitoringAgent monitoring. This is enabled through checkbox which shows up on back or restore pop ups.

**Note**: Restore is not supported for ManagedDatabase pods. Teams are advised **not** to attempt it.
